cases.case_label: Retroelement insertions in ATM (15 A-T individuals, aggregate; abstract only)
cases.mechanism_detail: Abstract reports 15 A-T individuals with retroelement insertions in ATM (14 noncoding); 12 of 14 intronic insertions caused or contributed to loss of function by exon skipping or cryptic splice-site activation, one deep intronic insertion causing cryptic exonization rescued by ASOs. Individual insertions are not detailed in the abstract.
cases.quote: Systematic functional characterization via RNA sequencing, RT-PCR, and/or minigene splicing assays showed that 12 out of 14 intronic insertions led or contributed to ATM loss of function by exon skipping or activating cryptic splice sites.
